hints.title: Monotonicity Invariant
hints.text: If all deliveries can be finished within time T, they can also be finished in any time greater than T.

hints.title: Feasibility Check
hints.text: Given candidate time T, each worker i completes floor(T / worker_rate[i]) deliveries.

hints.title: Binary Search on Time
hints.text: Search between 1 and the worst-case single worker time to find the minimal feasible duration.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minimumTime(self, deliveries: list[int], workers: list[int]) -> int:
        # Each worker i can deliver 1 package in workers[i] time
        # Find minimum time T such that total packages delivered >= sum(deliveries)
        target = sum(deliveries)
        low, high = 1, target * min(workers)
        ans = high
        while low <= high:
            mid = (low + high) // 2
            total = sum(mid // w for w in workers)
            if total >= target:
                ans = mid
                high = mid - 1
            else:
                low = mid + 1
        return ans
```

variables: MaxTime: upper bound on delivery time
complexity.notes: Binary search on answers with linear feasibility check.
